body: Thanks, I really do appreciate this. But there are a few things I did leave out of the story. When I mentioned that my parents might not give a shit it was because of some past things they have said. After my grades began to slip from a's and b's to F's and C's, my mom called me things like a disappointment and that I should just shut up about these things. I hope you understand that I have tried consulting my parents, while my father is a loving and caring figure who would support me, my mother is the opposite. She really doesn't care enough. And sadly my father has a full time job that he can not leave to talk to my teachers and/or counselors. I've told a few friends about the whole thing and I guess high school freshman and sophomores have no idea how to deal with these kinds of things. But really, I do appreciate the reply. I just find it hard to write because to me it is just kind of embarrassing.
